name: dev-kit
description: Plan-driven autonomous dev loop: /write-plan decomposes designs into one-verify tasks (1-2 tests + their implementation, roughly 5-10min; PLAN.md) with TDD enforcement (tier=standard: new-test-required verify), /execute-plan runs tier-routed builders (builder/sonnet with red->green TDD, builder-light/haiku) -> reviewer(read-only incl. no Bash-mediated edits; independent verdict with a requirement traceability table demanding measured evidence; risk:high tasks reviewed by opus upfront) per task, plus stage-reviewer integration review at stage boundaries, with PROGRESS.md + per-task git commit logging, RESUME checkpoint blocks (stage boundaries + PreCompact hook flush), and file-based pause (.dev-kit-pause). Parallel [P] groups run in per-task git worktrees (opt-in via project worktree: declaration, default off -> sequential) with a post-merge integration verify gate. Ships a PreToolUse hook that denies destructive Bash commands (DROP/TRUNCATE/rm -rf/git reset --hard/docker volume rm), the entire revert category (git checkout <path>/restore/clean/stash/rm/branch -D/reflog expire; branch switching and -b allowed), and out-of-scope Edit/Write via .dev-kit-scope (per-project exceptions via .dev-kit-allow-destructive), plus a harden skill for evidence-backed environment hardening (DB privileges, backups, dev/prod isolation). Includes brainstorming/grill/docs skills plus systematic debugging (root-cause-first, reproduce->isolate->trace->fix) and repo self-audit, with strict/flexible discipline tagging.
